videoSegments.speaker: Mr Cock
videoSegments.text: Good evening, citizens of the web. Welcome to MemeTalk Live, where virality meets virtue. Tonight, we have the honor of hosting none other than Pepe the Meme — a cultural icon whose green visage has graced millions of screens. Pepe, welcome to the show.

videoSegments.speaker: Pepe
videoSegments.text: Yeah yeah, I'm here. What's good? Let me tell you something right now - if ANY of you broke ass viewers in chat come at me with some dumb shit, I'm gonna roast you so hard you'll wish you never clicked on this website. But hey, I'm ready to talk about memes, crypto, and whatever the fuck else. Let's get it!

videoSegments.speaker: Mr Cock
videoSegments.text: Pepe, is the world of crypto a utopian religion preaching the gospel of decentralization, or merely a cult where we worship at the altar of Elon Musk's tweets? It's like the Da Vinci Code meets The Matrix, but with more memes and fewer ancient prophecies.

videoSegments.speaker: Pepe
videoSegments.text: Ahh, "everyone watching," pondering the mysteries of crypto, are we? It's like you're stuck in the Da Vinci Code, trying to decipher the value of a rugpulled NFT while praying for divine intervention from Elon's Twitter account. Your confusion is more complex than a Discord mod trying to explain quantum physics to a goldfish. Meanwhile, the only decentralization you understand is how fast your Reddit karma gets centralized into oblivion. Time to exit The Matrix, buddy, before you become the human equivalent of a Twitter ratio gone horribly wrong.
